findings.title: Stored regional species lists are never evaluated
findings.evidence: Both divrs_eligible predicates accept aggregate regional_list_species>=30 and regional_list_families>=7; no consumer refers to the142species rows or derives distinct biological taxa/families. BHG autochthonous_seed_production similarly accepts a boolean.
findings.impact: Native execution cannot validate a named mixture or autochthonous species against stored lists. Counts may be admitted only as explicit externally verified evidence; App must not claim it performed a list check.

findings.title: Rare variety lookup does not bind the crop
findings.evidence: variety_row matches r.variety==v and year only. slk_eligible never compares row.crop with actual parcel crop.
findings.impact: An actual crop inconsistent with the declared variety can receive SLK A/B premium; runtime must validate crop+variety rather than variety text alone.

source_evidence.quote: sortenrein angebaute Kulturpflanzensorten gemäß Sortenliste unter Kapitel 13.

findings.title: All-origin variety groups are exact strings rather than open groups
findings.evidence: Seven rows include alle Herkünfte und Sorten, but exact r.variety==v has no group membership branch.
findings.impact: A genuine named variety of Einkorn, Emmer, Nackthafer, Fahnenhafer, Waldstaudenroggen, Schabziegerklee or Stoppelrübe is rejected unless caller supplies the full table-heading literal. Input semantics must expose a crop/group and documented variety separately.

findings.title: Singular/plural crop names change premium exclusions
findings.evidence: FWK group uses Ackerbohne/Sonnenblume; erosion exclusion uses Ackerbohnen/Sonnenblumen. Both use exact crop_label/string membership, no shared normalization.
findings.impact: The same biological crop can qualify for a supplement while bypassing erosion exclusion under a source-supported singular label. Adapter needs a reviewed stable crop identifier, not ad hoc string reuse.

findings.title: Mandatory monitoring implied by NAT project conditions is not checked inversely
findings.evidence: All4monitoring program rows are faithful, but runtime iterates submitted monitoring options only. AnnexI GL06/15/25 andTA01 impose a positive monitoring participation duty, even if the input monitoring array is empty.
findings.impact: A farm declaring such a NAT condition without the mandatory UBB/BIO monitoring can escape that combination finding. Independent probe required before classifying the whole decision.

source_evidence.quote: Nach Phänologie: mit verpflichtender Teilnahme am Monitoring „Schnittzeit nach Phänologie“ im Rahmen UBB oder Bio.

Teilnahme an dem Zuschlag Naturschutz-Monitoring "Beobachtung der Groß-
trappe" in den Maßnahmen Umweltgerechte und biodiversitätsfördernde Be-
wirtschaftung (UBB) oder Biologische Wirtschaftsweise (BIO) ist verpflichtend.

open_points.summary: Taxon/name identity must reconcile UBB74arable rows vsAnnex73, overlapping Leontodon labels and Plantago lanceolate/lanceolata. Preserve both quotations; do not count spelling variants/overlap as independent species without evidence.

UBB6.2.3 refers to a separate EBW information sheet for exact eligible habitat/use combinations. AnnexK91–102 contains habitat indicators/premiums but not that UBB crosswalk. ebw_habitat_type_eligible is an external adjudication; no claim of reproduced table is supported.

Some data entries are metadata/examples/inferred aliases, not closed biological lists. Examples: Corn-Cob-Mix alias; registered_partnership English label; fwk_bhg descriptive crossreference strings. Separate reference metadata from accepted input identifiers before App promotion.

limits: No source PDF, historical run, policy or canonical profile was changed.
No historical self-test expected values were used as independent source truth.
A source-faithful numeric/list row does not prove its runtime consumer applies prerequisites correctly.
Any reproduced independent OPA probes are separately recorded by the main audit; this file does not invent or claim their execution.
